messages:
Maria L 11:02 UTC: prod ingress started dropping ~0.5% requests to asia-west1 for route /v1/text-gen-large after the recent route-priority flip.
Eli W: ack — can we divert traffic to a containment path to stop retries and isolate the failure?
Jun K: we have a containment route staged; can flip with emergency toggle. plan is to mark diverted traffic with header x-rw-emergency:true and send to fallback pool with smaller instances.
Ops Oncall: prefer canary 10% first. keep circuit-breaker and per-tenant quotas strict. avoid global weight changes.
Eli W: canary plan: sample 10% by request-id hash -> steer to containment pool 'fallback-small'. if stable 5m -> promote to 100%.
Jun K: toggle payload I'll run via internal API (minimal change):
```json
{"route":"containment/text-gen-large","match":{"path":"/v1/text-gen-large","header":"x-rw-emergency"},"actions":{"backend":"fallback-small","inject_header":"x-rw-emergency:true","circuit":{"max_rps":250,"err_pct":1.0}}}
```
Maria L: add logging of original-route, request-id, tenant-id. emit metrics: containment.requests, containment.errors, containment.latency.
Ops Oncall: deploy-bot, run the toggle and create an incident ticket.
Deploy Bot: running toggle job #8010
Deploy Bot: apply containment/text-gen-large -> SUCCESS (operator=Jun K)
Deploy Bot: propagated to ingress fleet in ~22s; snapshot sn-1905551234
Eli W: canary 10% active. telemetry: 5xx dropped 0.6% -> 0.12% over ~40s; median latency +5ms. :thumbsup:
Maria L: added Console tile under Routes > text-gen-large showing containment.requests & containment.errors, pinned to incident board inc-2027.
Ops Oncall: automation rule set: if containment.errors > 2% for 2m -> auto-disable containment and page SRE.
Jun K: rollback steps if needed:
1) routes disable containment/text-gen-large
2) remove injection rule
3) remove canary steering
4) revert circuit-breaker
5) confirm traffic and 5xx rates returned to baseline
Eli W: note containment pool enforces tighter quotas; 429s expected. if a customer is significantly affected, support should open a quota-bump request and include request-id samples.
Maria L: update runbook with this play (canary -> 100% -> follow-up fix), include the toggle UI screenshot and payload.
Ops Oncall: created incident INC-2027 and attached payload + sampling query for affected tenants.
Maria L: leaving this thread open. if containment stays stable for 30m, we'll schedule a config-level fix to avoid header matching. monitoring oncall.
